item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - The 2026 Juno Awards
item.description:
Hamilton, get ready! The JUNO Awards are back, bringing Canada’s Biggest Night in Music to TD Coliseum on Sunday, March 29th. Hosted by Mae Martin, experience electrifying live performances from some of the country’s biggest stars, including Alessia Cara, Allison Russell, Arkells, The Beaches, Cameron Whitcomb, Daniel Caesar, Jully Black, MICO, Sarah McLachlan, Shawn Desman, Sofia Camara, Tanya Tagaq, and William Prince!

Plus, don’t miss special appearances by Lifetime Achievement Award recipient Joni Mitchell and Canadian Music Hall of Fame Inductee Nelly Furtado.
Click to expand...
https://junoawards.ca/events/the-2026-juno-awards/

It will be airing on CBC this Sunday the 29th at 8pm. I've seen a lack of raw broadcast recordings of The Juno Awards as CBC's OTA feed is in 720p. So a 720p raw broadcast and a 1080p WEB-DL from CBC Gem would also be accepted cuz i've been more interested on the Joni Mitchell's Lifetime Achievement Award appearance when it's airing.

Thanks!
